resources.string: This device has data from an earlier version of Hootbook. A private copy is checked first, to show how much can be imported and what is not supported. The check does not change the original; normal use and sync stay paused until the upgrade is done.
Working on your private copy. Please keep this screen open.
The counts below come from a trial import into a separate temporary copy. Check each kind of record that is not imported before you continue.
This is a preview, not a completed migration. The final report will show the result returned by the actual import.

These source counts are separate from the import report. The default-account count is a saved selection, not an account record. You can recreate templates and select a default account after upgrading. Missing files cannot be recovered by the importer.
Financial records are included in the omissions

The report includes skipped financial records or settings, including any already-deleted records shown above. Review the category counts carefully. Transaction history and related details may differ after the upgrade. Export a recovery package before continuing if you need an independent copy.
I have reviewed the counts and field changes, and accept that the omitted items will not transfer to the new ledger.
Old sync bindings, device identifiers and sync keys do not transfer. Set up sync again after upgrading; the old cloud sync data is not imported.

These counts describe whole records, not every field change. Stored balance history is replaced by balance adjustments; earlier history can differ. Category mappings, duplicate names and currency codes may change. Unsupported transaction reference, recurring and billing-cycle fields and copied bank/account text do not transfer. Same-currency transfers use the sent amount. Some account details, budget account references and subscription recurrence settings are normalized or omitted. Original files remain available for recovery.
AI settings: could not be safely read. Original secure preferences are retained; set up AI again after upgrading.
AI settings: additional setup is required after upgrading. Any readable settings are prepared for import; a usable credential could not be confirmed.
AI settings: found in the source. Check the configuration after upgrading.
AI settings: none found in the source.
Brokerage settings: could not be safely read. Original secure preferences are retained; reconnect the brokerage service after upgrading. Source counts are unavailable.
Broker settings: found and ready to import.
Brokerage settings: none found in the source.

Prepared settings and source counts do not confirm that everything was accepted. Any reported unsupported connections appear in the omissions above. Check AI and brokerage settings after upgrading. Credentials are never displayed here.
Your data and settings have been upgraded. The report below shows what was actually imported. The original files are kept, including anything that was not carried over.

The import was interrupted before a verified result was saved. Some or all records may already be saved. The preview below is not proof of what was committed. Do not repeat the import: an automatic replay could duplicate or conflict with data. Your original files and recovery information are retained. Export a recovery package and resolve the import status before continuing.
The data import finished and was saved. Some settings or files still need to be applied; finish this step to continue. Your data will not be imported again.
A verified migration could not be prepared. Your original files are retained. You can export a recovery package or try checking the source again.
The last operation could not be verified. Your original files are retained. Check available storage and use the recovery action offered on this screen.
The operation stopped unexpectedly. Reload the saved migration status before taking another migration action. No import will be automatically replayed.
The saved migration report is incomplete. Reload the migration status to verify the actual result before continuing. Do not repeat the import.
The document chooser could not be opened. No recovery destination was selected. Try exporting again with an available document provider.
Your originals stay on this device
The original database, WAL, attachments and secure preference files are retained. Completing the upgrade does not delete them.

A recovery package preserves the available original data and migration information. It is for recovery, not a directly importable Hootbook backup. Keep this package private and choose a trusted destination.
Recovery package saved. The original files are still on this device. Exporting does not change the migration status.

This package contains private financial information and service settings, which may include credentials. Choose a trusted destination in the Android document chooser. Anyone with access to the package may be able to read its contents. This is a recovery package, not an importable Hootbook backup.
This only says whether a provider and key are saved; it does not check that the AI service accepts the key.
